title: nan
authors: Pestana J.; Mellado-Bataller I.; Sanchez-Lopez J.L.; Fu C.; Mondragón I.F.; Campoy P.
key_contribution: Presents a configurable controller architecture for indoor/outdoor GPS-denied navigation of multirotor UAVs using optical-flow odometry, validated experimentally.
